Several variables predispose some people to alcoholic liver 
disease. These include genetic polymorphisms of alcohol- 
metabolizing enzymes, gender (women more than men), 
simultaneous exposure to other drugs, infections with hepato-
tropic viruses, immunologic factors, obesity, and poor nutrition 
status. The pathogenesis of alcoholic liver disease progresses in 
three stages (see Figure 29-2): hepatic steatosis (see Figure 29-3), 
alcoholic hepatitis, and finally cirrhosis.
